reconnecting: Connection lost — reconnecting. Showing the last update.

notFound.title: This display link doesn’t work
notFound.body: It may have been replaced with a new link. Ask your facility manager for the current one.

off.title: This display is switched off
off.body: It can be switched on again in FacilityPro → Settings → TV displays.

manage.intro: Show live work order status on a TV or wall screen, like an “order ready” board. Open the link on the screen’s browser — no sign-in needed. It updates itself every 20 seconds.
manage.rotated: New link created — the old link no longer works
manage.name: Name
manage.doneFor: Keep finished work on screen for
manage.privacy: Anyone who can see the screen sees these. Instructions, requester details and costs are never shown.
manage.rotateBody: Screens using the current link for “{{name}}” stop working until you open the new link on them.
manage.deleteBody: Delete “{{name}}”? Screens showing it will stop.
manage.shareHint: Open this link in the TV’s browser (or a stick like Fire TV / Chromecast / Android TV box), then press Full screen. Anyone with the link can view the board, so share it only with the screen.
manage.qrSubtitle: Scan to open the work order display
